Hill Country Developers Forum

Inaugural Event · May 19, 2026 · Fredericksburg, Texas

An exclusive gathering of developers, surveyors, planners, and local industry professionals for a meaningful conversation about the future of development in the Texas Hill Country.

📅 May 19, 2026 · 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM CT
📍 Texas Wine Collective · Fredericksburg, TX
🍽️ Lunch Provided

Welcome

About This Forum

We are pleased to welcome you to the inaugural Hill Country Developers Forum — a curated event designed to bring together the voices shaping growth and development across one of Texas's most dynamic and beloved regions. Attendees will gain valuable insight into the challenges and opportunities shaping development in the Hill Country while connecting with fellow professionals and community leaders. Space is limited to encourage quality discussion and meaningful networking.

Featured Speakers

Meet the Presenters

Cody J. Musick, RPLS
CEO · Waymaker Land Advisors & Surveyors

A licensed Registered Professional Land Surveyor and the CEO of Waymaker Land Advisors & Surveyors, Cody brings deep expertise in land advisory and survey services across the Texas Hill Country.

Kendra Pesek, PLLC
Executive Vice President · Hill Country Titles

Kendra serves as Executive Vice President at Hill Country Titles, bringing extensive knowledge of real estate title services and transactional expertise specific to development in the region.

Shelby Collier
Founder · C3 Development Services

Shelby is the founder of C3 Development Services and a recognized expert in Hill Country development policy. Her presentation, Evolution of Development in the Texas Hill Country, will explore the past, present, and future of development policy and process.
